name: Jakarta
literature_vertical_cm_per_yr: -1 to -15 average (-7.3 to -7.7 recent multi-track InSAR; historical hotspots -20 to -28)
literature_sources: Hakim et al. / Andreas et al. Sentinel-1 & GNSS InSAR studies
agreement_note: 108-day LOS (-6.8 cm, -9.3 cm vertical est.) is within historical hotspot range, but valid pixel fraction is only 3.0% due to tropical vegetation/urban decorrelation and only 1 coastal reference window (106.911E, -6.116S) was usable.
press_summary_gate_note: Indicative only (valid_fraction 3.0% < 40%, n_references=1). Exclude from press headline numbers.

first_nisar_measurement.evidence: No peer-reviewed NISAR Jakarta subsidence paper found as of 2026-11-14; tropical coherence limits spaceborne measurement.
first_nisar_measurement.atlas_first_claim_note: Multi-basin standardized atlas phrasing must use qualified (to our knowledge) only after excluding Mexico City from any individual-first claim.

quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
